stemMd: A plant leaf is moved into darkness. Which process loses its direct energy input immediately?
explanationMd: Photochemical excitation requires photons and therefore loses its input in darkness. Respiration and many other cellular processes can continue, so darkness should not be equated with instant cessation of metabolism.

distractorRationale.b: Many reactions continue temporarily or through respiration.
distractorRationale.c: Base pairing is not driven directly by light.
distractorRationale.a: Respiration does not require incident light.
